name: io.github.xmasdong/mazediy-mcp
title: MazeDIY Maze Generator
description: Generate printable mazes in any shape or country outline, with answer keys.

tools.name: generate_maze
tools.description: Generate a printable maze as SVG, ASCII text or JSON. Shapes: rectangle, circle, heart, star, diamond, triangle, hexagon, or the outline of any country (pass `country`). Every maze has exactly one solution; set show_solution for an answer key. The same seed always gives the same maze.

shape.description: Maze outline. Use "country" together with the `country` field.

country.description: Country name, ISO code or alias, e.g. "Italy", "JP", "USA". Implies shape "country".

size.description: Cells along the longer side. 10-15 suits young children, 20-30 older kids, 40+ adults.

width.description: Rectangle only: cells across. Overrides size.

height.description: Rectangle only: cells down. Overrides size.

seed.description: Reuse a seed to regenerate the same maze.

format.description: svg for printing, ascii for chat (best at size 25 or less), json for programs.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List the countries available for country-shaped mazes. Filter by part of a name or code, or by continent (Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, Oceania, Antarctica).

tools.name: find_printable_mazes
tools.description: Search 2,000+ free printable mazes on MazeDIY (animals, dinosaurs, holidays, vehicles, food, countries, US states and more). Each result links to a page with a print-ready maze. Leave the query empty to list themes.

query.description: What the maze should look like, e.g. "dinosaur", "christmas tree", "Texas".

theme.description: Limit to one theme, e.g. "Animal Mazes".
